tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a project website URL for security vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, open redirects, security header misconfigurations, exposed files, and more. Returns a comprehensive report with findings ranked by severity.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

url.description: The full URL to scan (e.g., https://example.com)

max_depth.description: Crawl depth for endpoint discovery (0-5, default 2)

zap_profile.description: Active scan profile (ProjectDiscovery nuclei): baseline (~15s, passive only), fast (~30s, limited active), thorough (~2-5min, full active)

auth_headers.description: HTTP headers to send with every request (e.g., {"Authorization": "Bearer xxx"}). Used for authenticated scanning.

auth_cookies.description: Cookies to send with every request (e.g., {"session_id": "abc123"}). Used for session-based authentication.

tools.name: get_scan_results
tools.description: Retrieve the results of a previously completed scan by its scan ID and project ID.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

scan_id.description: The scan ID returned by scan_website or run_project_scan

tools.name: list_scans
tools.description: List all scans for a project with their IDs, status, and targets. Use this to find scan IDs for get_scan_results.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

tools.name: profile_site
tools.description: Profile a project website's technology stack — identifies frameworks, hosting, CDN, analytics, auth providers, payment integrations, and UI libraries. Uses 50 built-in detectors plus WhatWeb (1800+ plugins). Takes ~1-3s.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

url.description: The full URL to profile (e.g., https://example.com)

tools.name: performance_check
tools.description: Measure Core Web Vitals and page performance for a project. Returns LCP, TBT, CLS, FCP, SI metrics, category scores, and improvement opportunities with AI-powered fix suggestions. Takes ~10-30s.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

url.description: The full URL to analyze (e.g., https://example.com)

tools.name: seo_check
tools.description: Run SEO or AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) analysis on a project URL. SEO mode checks meta tags, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap, headings, images, links. AEO mode checks AI bot access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot), structured data for AI extraction, content structure, and citation quality. Uses Playwright rendering for JS-heavy sites. Takes ~5-15s.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

url.description: The full URL to analyze (e.g., https://example.com)

mode.description: Analysis mode: 'seo' for traditional SEO checks, 'aeo' for AI search engine optimization

tools.name: accessibility_check
tools.description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a project URL using axe-core and Playwright. Checks color contrast, ARIA attributes, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, image alt text, form labels, and more. Returns violations grouped by impact level with CSS selectors and AI fix prompts. Takes ~5-15s.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

url.description: The full URL to audit (e.g., https://example.com)

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects for the authenticated organization. Shows project name, URL, scan count, and issue summary by scan type (passive, SEO, AEO, performance, accessibility, code).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project with a name and URL to scan. Optionally link a GitHub repository for code scanning.

github_repo_url.description: Optional GitHub repository URL for code scanning

tools.name: run_project_scan
tools.description: Run all applicable scans on a project: passive security scan, technology profiling, SEO analysis, AEO analysis, performance analysis, accessibility audit, and code scanning (if GitHub connected). Active scans are not included.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

tools.name: get_project_scans
tools.description: List all scans for a project, showing status, target, findings count, and timestamps.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

tools.name: deliverability_check
tools.description: Check email deliverability DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DNSSEC, BIMI, reverse DNS, DANE) for a domain. Validates SPF include chains, DMARC subdomain policy and enforcement percentage, MTA-STS HTTPS policy, DKIM key strength and revocation, and BIMI DMARC prerequisites. Returns pass/fail/warn/info status for each check with a weighted score.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List all connected third-party service integrations (GitHub, Vercel, Netlify, Supabase, Cloudflare, Firebase, Railway, Stripe, Fly.io, Render) and their connection status. Shows which providers are active and when they were last tested.

tools.name: scan_integrations
tools.description: Run a security analysis on all connected provider integrations. Checks each provider's API for security misconfigurations (SSL mode, WAF rules, branch protection, RLS policies, webhook HTTPS, etc.) and returns a per-provider score with pass/fail/warn status for each check.

provider.description: Optional: scan a specific provider only (e.g., 'cloudflare', 'github'). If omitted, scans all connected providers.

tools.name: list_code_scans
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow security scan results for a project. Shows findings from CI/CD pipeline analysis including hardcoded secrets, unpinned actions, excessive permissions, and dangerous workflow patterns.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

tools.name: issue_badge
tools.description: Issue a Vergate Verified badge for a domain. Creates a trust badge that site owners can embed to prove their site has been verified by Vergate. Requires 0 critical findings in the latest scan. Returns embed code and token.

project_id.description: The project ID from list_projects (optional — auto-pinned when VERGATE_PROJECT_ID is set)

domain.description: The domain to issue badge for (e.g., example.com)

tools.name: verify_badge
tools.description: Verify a Vergate Verified badge token. Returns badge status, domain, safe analytics (SEO, AEO, performance, accessibility scores), technology stack, and security summary. No vulnerability details are exposed.
